heading: Terminal nodes
text:
## Terminal nodes [IRET.8]

A terminal is where a fully-matched token becomes a firing. It holds the
rule's name (interned), its ordering weight and its RHS action list. It
holds no truth-maintenance flag: whether a firing records a justification is
decided per action ([IRET.8.3]).

**The terminal ordinal is the agenda's FIRST key.** It is the rule's
zero-based index in the artefact's terminal sequence, which is canonical
source order ([RLOW.14.3]) — so the comparator reads it directly and no
per-rule annotation or lookup is needed. `[LDET.5.4]` is the normative
statement.

`ds_rete_terminal_t` is declared in `runtime/src/libds/rete/terminal.h`.
